tx.finality.out-of-scope.decided_by: [SRC] bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 at 6504a3aff65ba97c0f6c80962b033e35ecbfed4b: validation.cpp:227–247 (IsFinalTx), :5977–5993 (ContextualCheckTransaction: block bad-txns-nonfinal; after Genesis an off-block non-final transaction routes to the non-final pool, :912–926), :257–336 (CalculateSequenceLocks/EvaluateSequenceLocks), :3345–3348 (block BIP68 refusal), :1201–1203 (mempool non-BIP68-final); policy.h:247–255 (StandardNonFinalVerifyFlags: sequence locks before Genesis only). docs/DESIGN.md §5.5: block-level rules, the UTXO set, ordering and maturity are outside the transaction gate, #36.
tx.finality.out-of-scope.note: the scripts and the transaction-level gate are satisfied and the spec says valid; the reference refuses the transaction for a rule outside the script verdict's scope (the transaction's own finality against the chain), which the spec does not model at S3 (#36, S5): recorded as a witness so the boundary is executed, never a spec bug and never an engine bug
